criteria.text: Before submission, pdd reads authenticated runtime capacity and waits through announced maintenance, showing its local end time with the zone and its reason before rechecking.
When the server confirms that maintenance prevented a job from starting, pdd uses the same maintenance wait and notice.
A runtime without the capacity endpoint can still accept work under its ordinary submission rules.
Maintenance waiting obeys the caller deadline and interruption.
Authentication, access and unrelated service errors retain their existing handling.
Even when maintenance ends more than 24.8 days away, pdd waits at most 60 seconds at a time and stays responsive without rapid polling or repeated unchanged notices.
An unrecognized capacity response or read failure prints one warning and continues with ordinary admission rules; only clear future maintenance creates a maintenance wait.

cases.given: capacity announces deploy until fixed future time, then clear
cases.required_observation: no POST during window; one POST after recheck; print reason and local end time with its zone

cases.given: capacity 404, POST 503 maintenance/not_started with a future until and reason, Retry-After
cases.required_observation: show reason and local end time with its zone; wait, recheck 404, retry safely

cases.given: local zone America/Los_Angeles; synthetic future maintenance until 2026-07-02T02:25:00.000Z, separately from capacity and confirmed not-started 503
cases.required_observation: human notice shows local hour/minute 19:25 and PDT with the supplied reason; existing machine JSON schema, values and accounting remain unchanged, with no added until field or localized maintenance time; raw admission saved from a confirmed not-started 503 retains original until 2026-07-02T02:25:00.000Z; no complete sentence wording is fixed

cases.given: local zone America/Los_Angeles; synthetic future maintenance until 2026-12-01T03:25:00.000Z
cases.required_observation: human notice shows local hour/minute 19:25 and PST; it does not reuse the summer zone

cases.given: local zone America/Los_Angeles; synthetic current time 2026-11-01T08:59:50.000Z, maintenance until 2026-11-01T09:00:10.000Z across the daylight-saving boundary
cases.required_observation: human notice shows end hour/minute 01:00 with PST, the zone at the end instant; waiting still follows the supplied UTC instant

cases.given: local zone Asia/Tokyo; synthetic future maintenance until 2026-07-02T02:25:00.000Z
cases.required_observation: human notice shows local hour/minute 11:25 and its zone; no Pacific zone or UTC end-time string is substituted; existing machine JSON schema, values and accounting remain unchanged, with no added until field or localized maintenance time; raw admission data retains the original UTC until where already captured

cases.given: window exceeds agent 90 s, separately interrupt
cases.required_observation: no later POST; finite wait and plain progress
existing immediate gate, no maintenance loop

cases.given: synthetic clock 0, capacity maintenance until 2592000000 ms (30 days), terminal wait; first sleep reaches 60000 then recheck; interrupt after second chunk
cases.required_observation: each sleep >0 and <=60000; capacity rechecked after each chunk, no overflow to 1 ms/hot loop, one unchanged-window notice; no POST during window or after interruption

cases.given: capacity 404; confirmed not-started 503 maintenance until 2592000000 ms with Retry-After, then bounded waits; interrupt or finite deadline separately
cases.required_observation: same <=60000 ms positive chunks and rechecks apply to admission maintenance; no unsafe retry, no repeated unchanged notice, no overflow; original raw UTC until, usage and request IDs retained

cases.given: capacity HTML 200, 405, unrecognized 500, timeout and unreachable read separately; ordinary submission accepts
cases.required_observation: one finite stderr warning per command, continue to existing admission within remaining deadline, no indefinite capacity wait; zero-call lint then ordinary check/Try path; valid unchanged JSON output

cases.given: unrecognized capacity read followed by submission 401, not-invited, no-cloud-access, update-required, cloud-unavailable, legacy opens-soon or uncertain POST separately
cases.required_observation: ordinary gate handling remains authoritative; no silent wait, new paid retry or fabricated success; uncertain POST is read only by its saved ID

cases.given: capacity itself returns recognized 401, not-invited, no-cloud-access, update-required, cloud-unavailable and legacy opens-soon separately
cases.required_observation: existing stop behavior takes precedence; zero new submission POSTs and no maintenance loop

cases.given: capacity contains maintenance null, malformed until or past until separately
cases.required_observation: no maintenance wait; preserve ordinary submission/admission and do not invent a future end time

cases.given: first submission sees unrecognized capacity and warns; a later refreshed read in same command announces valid future maintenance
cases.required_observation: warning is not repeated; failed read is not cached as clear and cannot hide the later maintenance window; pause before new POST with local end time and reason
